procedure_text: 将2-氯甲苯、催化剂无水三氯化铝和溶剂加入到反应瓶中，在0℃-15℃间滴加甲磺酰氯，滴加完毕，升至室温继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，将反应物倒入冰水中，用溶剂萃取，浓缩，得2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
procedure_summary: 2-Chlorotoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and a solvent are charged into a reaction flask, methanesulfonyl chloride is added dropwise while cold, and the mixture is then warmed to room temperature and followed by LC to completion. The mixture is poured into ice water, extracted and concentrated to give the aryl methyl sulfone.
notes: PROSE step, from the numbered recitation of the route in 发明内容. Heading [0006]: 1)2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成. Two conventions are used across every record of this section: (a) compounds[] carries the species charged into the reaction - reactants, reagents, catalysts, bases - while quench, acidification and wash agents live in workup instead; (b) reactant_names lists every compounds[] entry that is not the product, not a catalyst and not a solvent. TEMPERATURE: the recorded 0-15 C range is the addition temperature (在0℃-15℃间滴加); after the addition the mixture is 升至室温继续反应 with no time stated, so time_h is null. AlCl3 is recorded as catalyst because the text calls it 催化剂. DRAWING CONFLICT: the scheme at line 174 has no counterpart for this step. Its first arrow starts from 2,6-dichlorotoluene and uses CH3SNa - the very reagent [0004] says the invention 革除了 - and neither 2-氯甲苯 nor 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯 appears anywhere in the drawing; 甲磺酰氯 appears on no arrow. See Scheme Step 1.

It is quenched into ice water and hydrochloric acid, the layers are separated, the aqueous layer is extracted, and the combined organic phases are washed with water and concentrated to the aryl methyl ketone.
notes: PROSE step. Heading [0008]: 2)2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成. procedure_text: 将2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中，加入适量的过氧苯甲酸，在回流的条件下，滴加溴素，滴完后继续反应1-10h，冷却，水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
procedure_summary: The methyl ester is dissolved in a solvent, peroxybenzoic acid is added and bromine is run in dropwise at reflux; the mixture is then held at reflux, cooled, washed with water and concentrated to the benzylic bromide.
notes: PROSE step. Heading [0014]: 5)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成. This is a side-chain (benzylic) bromination: 过氧苯甲酸 is a peroxide initiator and 溴素 is elemental bromine, added dropwise at reflux, so mechanism_type is radical. named_reaction is deliberately null: Wohl-Ziegler names the NBS bromination specifically, and [0031] states that this process uses 溴素 in place of NBS, so applying that name here would be a stretch. peroxybenzoic acid is recorded as catalyst because it is the initiator; the text gives it neither role nor amount, only 适量. Solvent written only as 溶剂; [0024] permits 四氯化碳, 氯仿, 二氯甲烷 or 1,2-二氯乙烷, all halogenated. 继续反应1-10h is a range, so time_h is null. catalyst_class is skipped rather than guessed - the tag vocabulary has no value for a radical initiator. FLAG: Scheme Step 6 draws only Br2 over the arrow, with no initiator, so 过氧苯甲酸 is written but not drawn. That same arrow is the one place the drawing agrees with the invention's claimed improvement over NBS - see Scheme Step 6.

procedure_text: 将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中，加入2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠，在室温下搅拌，然后水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯，将残余物溶于溶剂中，加入氢氧化钠水溶液，回流反应1-4h，冷却，加入稀盐酸酸化，溶剂萃取，水洗干燥浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide is dissolved in a solvent and treated with sodium trifluoroethoxide at room temperature, then washed and concentrated to the ester intermediate. The residue is redissolved, aqueous sodium hydroxide is added and the mixture is refluxed, then cooled, acidified with dilute hydrochloric acid, extracted, washed, dried and concentrated to the free benzoic acid.
notes: PROSE step. Heading [0016]: 6)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成. TWO TRANSFORMATIONS IN ONE NUMBERED STEP: (i) a Williamson-type displacement of the benzylic bromide by 2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠 at room temperature, and (ii) hydrolysis of the ester with 氢氧化钠水溶液 at reflux. is_one_pot is false, not true, because the text interposes a real workup between them - 水洗，浓缩得...，将残余物溶于溶剂中 - and the one-pot rule requires no workup between the transformations. The record is nevertheless kept as ONE record because the document numbers it as one step, 6); an extractor that splits on workup would emit two here, and that is where a step-count disagreement would surface. reaction_class is taken from the final transformation, hydrolysis, following the one-pot convention; the first transformation is carried in tags as transformation:etherification. Conditions are composite: room temperature for (i), reflux 1-4h for (ii); the 1-4h range cannot be held by the single-valued time_h field so it is null. INTERNAL TEXT ANOMALY, not corrected: the Chinese names the isolated intermediate 苯甲酸乙酯, the ETHYL ester, although the substrate charged is the 甲酯 (methyl ester) and nothing in the step introduces an ethyl group; the EN line repeats ETHYL. Recorded as written; this is not translation_conflict, because the Chinese and the English agree with each other - the inconsistency is internal to the Chinese. Solvent written only as 溶剂; [0025] permits 四氢呋喃, 乙腈, 二氯甲烷 or 甲苯, which span different solvent classes, so solvent_class is skipped rather than guessed. FLAG: Scheme Step 7 draws only CF3CH2ONa over the arrow and carries the substrate straight to the free acid, so 氢氧化钠 is written here but is on no arrow.

procedure_text: 在反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺和溶剂，在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜，升温回流搅拌，蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷，冷却后，加入环己二酮和碱的混合物，室温搅拌，反应物水洗，干燥，浓缩得油状物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯；
procedure_summary: The benzoic acid, N,N-dimethylformamide and a solvent are charged into a flask, thionyl chloride is added dropwise at room temperature and the mixture is stirred at reflux to form the acid chloride. The solvent is distilled off, dichloromethane is added to the residue and, after cooling, a mixture of cyclohexane-1,3-dione and a base is added and stirred at room temperature; the mixture is washed with water, dried and concentrated to the enol ester as an oil.
notes: PROSE step. Heading [0018]: 7)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基）甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯的合成. ONE-POT: two sequential transformations with no isolation between them - the acid chloride is never worked up, only the solvent is exchanged (蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷), so is_one_pot is true and reaction_class is taken from the final transformation, the O-esterification that gives the enol ester. The acid chloride itself is never named in the text and so gets no compound record. THE BASE IS UNSPECIFIED: the step says only 碱; [0026] calls it 无机碱或有机碱, [0027] lists 碳酸钠, 碳酸钾, 氢氧化钠, 氢氧化钾 and [0028] lists 吡啶 or 三乙胺, without saying which is used, so no base compound is recorded here and catalyst_class is skipped. Dichloromethane IS recorded as a compound, unlike the generic 溶剂 of the other steps, because this step names it explicitly. 冷却后 states cooling with no method, so cooling_method stays null. No time is given for either transformation. FLAG: Scheme Step 8 draws this transformation with no arrow and no reagent at all, so 氯化亚砜, N,N-二甲基甲酰胺, 环己二酮 and the base are all written but undrawn.
